items_flat.title_en: Amodei publishes ‘We Must Pace the Frontier’; Anthropic commits to embedded evaluators
items_flat.title_zh: Amodei 發表〈我們必須放慢前沿節奏〉；Anthropic 承諾駐廠獨立評估
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published an essay arguing labs should slow the rate of capability gains so safety work can keep up, while saying this is not a halt to training. Anthropic unilaterally committed to step one: permanent, employee-level access for third-party evaluators who can verify safety practices, report incidents, and publish findings. Coverage over the weekend added Musk’s “Dario is right,” Hassabis’s endorsement of the direction, and Altman’s matching-evaluators pledge.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 執行長 Dario Amodei 發表長文，主張實驗室應放慢能力躍進速度好讓安全工作跟上，並強調這不是停止訓練。公司單方面承諾第一步：給予第三方評估者永久、等同員工的系統存取，以核驗安全措施、通報事故並可公開發現。週末後續報導加入 Musk「Dario is right」、Hassabis 認同方向，以及 Altman 承諾對齊駐廠評估。
items_flat.analysis_en: The concrete change is verifiability inside Anthropic, not a published training freeze. Whether other labs accept the same access terms, publication rights, and any coordinated pace remains uncontracted.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 眼前可核實的改變是公司內部可驗證性，而非已公布的訓練凍結。其他實驗室是否接受同等存取條件、公開權，以及是否真有協調節奏，仍無合約可查。
items_flat.quote: We must slow the pace at which we improve the capabilities of AI models. Progress will still seem fast, and we must make wise use of the time we gain.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們必須放慢提升 AI 模型能力的節奏。進展看起來仍會很快，我們必須善用爭取到的時間。

items_flat.title_en: Altman says OpenAI will match embedded evaluators and will not IPO in 2026
items_flat.title_zh: Altman：OpenAI 將對齊駐廠評估，且 2026 年不會 IPO
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman replied that he agrees the industry needs to pace the frontier and that OpenAI will also give independent evaluators employee-like access, with more detail later. Weekend coverage and a Fortune interview circulating since Saturday also have him calling a 2026 IPO ill-advised amid safety concerns. The Guardian grouped his reply with Musk’s endorsement of Amodei’s plan.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 回應稱同意產業需要放慢前沿節奏，OpenAI 也將給予獨立評估者等同員工的存取，細節稍後公布。週末流通的 Fortune 訪談中，他亦稱 2026 年 IPO 在安全疑慮下並不明智。《衛報》將其回應與 Musk 對 Amodei 方案的背書並列。
items_flat.analysis_en: Matching Anthropic’s slogan is easier than matching its access terms, publication rights, and any coordinated pause. The IPO delay is a financing-timeline signal, not evidence that training schedules have changed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 對齊口號比對齊存取條件、公開權與任何協調性暫停容易。IPO 延後是融資時程訊號，並不能證明訓練排程已改。
items_flat.quote: I agree with Dario that we need to pace the frontier. Committing to having independent evaluators with employee-like access is a great idea, and we will do the same. We’ll have more to share soon.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我同意 Dario：我們需要放慢前沿節奏。承諾讓獨立評估者擁有等同員工的存取是好主意，我們也會這麼做。稍後再公布細節。

items_flat.title_en: The Information: OpenAI, Anthropic and Google have met since July on an industry standards body
items_flat.title_zh: 《The Information》：三家自七月起討論產業主導的 AI 標準機構
items_flat.summary_en: The Information reported that Anthropic, OpenAI and Google have held working-group meetings since July on an industry-led body for testing and auditing frontier AI, predating Amodei’s Saturday essay. Demis Hassabis separately said Amodei’s direction is right and pointed to DeepMind’s recent proposal for an industry-wide frontier-AI standards body. Altman reportedly told an OpenAI all-hands he supports such an organization but wants major labs to lead it rather than wait on the U.S. government.
items_flat.summary_zh: 《The Information》報導，Anthropic、OpenAI 與 Google 自七月起已召開工作會議，討論由產業主導、負責前沿模型測試與稽核的機構，時間早於 Amodei 週六長文。Demis Hassabis 另表示 Amodei 方向正確，並指向 DeepMind 近日提出的產業級前沿 AI 標準機構方案。據報 Altman 在全員會上支持此類組織，但主張由大實驗室主導，而非等待美國政府推動。
items_flat.analysis_en: Talks since July explain why the weekend rhetoric aligned so quickly; they do not yet equal a charter, membership list, or enforcement power. Antitrust clearance for any joint ‘speed limit’ is still an explicit political ask.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 七月起的密談解釋了週末口徑為何迅速對齊；這仍不等於章程、成員名單或執行力。任何聯合「限速」仍需反壟斷豁免，屬明確的政治請求。
items_flat.quote: Dario's essay points towards the right path forward. The details need working through, but the direction is correct for meeting this critical moment. This is also why we recently put out our proposal for an industry-wide standards body for frontier AI.
items_flat.quote_zh: Dario 的文章指向正確方向。細節仍待敲定，但方向符合此刻的緊要性。這也是我們近日提出產業級前沿 AI 標準機構方案的原因。

items_flat.title_en: Grok models become selectable inside Microsoft Copilot
items_flat.title_zh: Grok 模型可在 Microsoft Copilot 中選用
items_flat.summary_en: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said more model choice is coming to Copilot and welcomed Grok; Elon Musk posted that Grok is available in Microsoft Copilot. Reporting describes a Frontier-program rollout across Word, Excel and PowerPoint that is admin-gated. Separately on September 13 Musk promoted a three-day Grok Bot Galaxy livestream starting September 15 showing products built live with Grok Bot.
items_flat.summary_zh: 微軟執行長 Satya Nadella 表示 Copilot 將提供更多模型選擇並歡迎 Grok；Elon Musk 發文稱 Grok 已可在 Microsoft Copilot 使用。報導指此為面向 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 的 Frontier 方案、需管理員開啟。9 月 13 日 Musk 另宣傳 9 月 15 日起為期三天的 Grok Bot Galaxy 直播，現場用 Grok Bot 從零打造產品。
items_flat.analysis_en: Copilot widens xAI’s enterprise distribution through Microsoft’s work surface, but admin opt-in and regional carve-outs limit immediate scale. The livestream is marketing for Grok Bot, not a Grok 4.7 launch; that model still has no official xAI page.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 進入 Copilot 擴大了 xAI 在微軟工作介面的企業通路，但管理員開啟與區域限制會壓低即時規模。直播是 Grok Bot 行銷，不是 Grok 4.7 發表；該模型仍無 xAI 官方頁面。
items_flat.quote: Watch a company being built live with @Grok @Bot!
items_flat.quote_zh: 看一家公司用 Grok Bot 現場被打造出來！

links.label: Elon Musk on X (Grok Bot Galaxy)

items_flat.title_en: King Charles to convene Nvidia, Google DeepMind, OpenAI and Anthropic leaders in Scotland
items_flat.title_zh: 英王查爾斯將在蘇格蘭召集 Nvidia、DeepMind、OpenAI、Anthropic 高層
items_flat.summary_en: Buckingham Palace said King Charles III will meet leaders from Nvidia, Google, DeepMind, OpenAI and Anthropic at Dumfries House in Ayrshire to discuss developing and deploying AI in ways that benefit society. OpenAI said CFO Sarah Friar will attend; the palace did not publish a full guest list. UK reporting adds Jensen Huang and Demis Hassabis among those understood to be present, with the Ditchley Foundation preparing a draft principles charter.
items_flat.summary_zh: 白金漢宮表示，英王查爾斯三世將在艾爾郡 Dumfries House 會見 Nvidia、Google、DeepMind、OpenAI 與 Anthropic 等機構代表，討論如何以有益社會的方式發展與部署 AI。OpenAI 證實財務長 Sarah Friar 將出席；宮方未公布完整名單。英媒稱黃仁勳、Hassabis 可望與會，Ditchley Foundation 並草擬原則憲章。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a convening, not a lab product or treaty. Its value depends on whether attendees leave with shared principles or only photo-ops after a weekend of ‘pace the frontier’ rhetoric.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是召集場合，不是實驗室產品或條約。價值取決於會後是否留下共同原則，而非週末「放慢前沿」論述之後的合影。
items_flat.quote: to discuss how A.I. can be developed and deployed in ways that benefit society
items_flat.quote_zh: 討論如何以有益社會的方式發展與部署人工智慧

items_flat.title_en: DeepSeek begins routing V4-Pro API traffic to V4.1-Flash
items_flat.title_zh: DeepSeek 開始把 V4-Pro API 流量導向 V4.1-Flash
items_flat.summary_en: DeepSeek’s official announcement says that from 04:00 UTC on September 14, 2026, requests to deepseek-v4-pro will route to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at Flash rates until V4.1-Pro launches. V4.1-Flash is the 552B-parameter multimodal MoE in its new architecture family, with 8B active parameters on input and 16B on output. Older V4-Flash aliases already route to V4.1-Flash.
items_flat.summary_zh: DeepSeek 官方公告寫明：自 2026 年 9 月 14 日 04:00 UTC 起，對 deepseek-v4-pro 的請求將路由至 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash，並按 Flash 費率計價，直到 V4.1-Pro 上線。V4.1-Flash 是新架構家族中 5520 億參數的多模態 MoE，輸入啟動約 80 億、輸出約 160 億參數。舊版 V4-Flash 別名已導向 V4.1-Flash。
items_flat.analysis_en: The in-window event is a production routing and pricing cutover, not a brand-new paper drop today. Customers still on the Pro alias should expect Flash behavior and Flash bills unless DeepSeek later reverses the footnote in docs.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 視窗內事件是正式環境的路由與計價切換，不是今天新發論文。仍使用 Pro 別名的客戶應預期 Flash 行為與 Flash 帳單，除非官方文件之後改口。
items_flat.quote: Starting at 04:00 UTC on Sept 14, 2026, all deepseek-v4-pro requests will route to V4.1-Flash at V4.1-Flash rates. This will continue until V4.1-Pro launches.
items_flat.quote_zh: 自 2026 年 9 月 14 日 04:00 UTC 起，所有 deepseek-v4-pro 請求將路由至 V4.1-Flash，並按 V4.1-Flash 費率計價，直至 V4.1-Pro 上線。

items_flat.title_en: Safety researchers from Anthropic and DeepMind join METR
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 與 DeepMind 安全研究員加入 METR
items_flat.summary_en: Joe Benton, who said he left Anthropic’s safety team, announced he is joining independent evaluator METR and argued companies are racing toward systems smarter than any human. Coverage also says Josh Engels moved from Google DeepMind to METR. The moves sit beside Amodei’s call to embed such evaluators inside labs.
items_flat.summary_zh: 自稱離開 Anthropic 安全團隊的 Joe Benton 宣布加入獨立評估機構 METR，並稱公司正競相打造強過任何人的系統。報導亦指 Josh Engels 自 Google DeepMind 轉赴 METR。人事流動恰好對上 Amodei 要把此類評估者嵌進實驗室的呼籲。
items_flat.analysis_en: Talent flowing into the evaluator named in the pacing plan is a structural signal, but METR’s forthcoming access rights at each lab are not yet public contracts.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 人才流向「放慢節奏」方案點名的評估機構是結構訊號，但 METR 在各實驗室的即將到來的存取權尚未成為公開合約。

frontier_other.summary_en: Joe Benton, who said he left Anthropic’s safety team, announced he is joining independent evaluator METR and argued companies are racing toward systems smarter than any human. Coverage also says Josh Engels moved from Google DeepMind to METR. The moves sit beside Amodei’s call to embed such evaluators inside labs.
frontier_other.summary_zh: 自稱離開 Anthropic 安全團隊的 Joe Benton 宣布加入獨立評估機構 METR，並稱公司正競相打造強過任何人的系統。報導亦指 Josh Engels 自 Google DeepMind 轉赴 METR。人事流動恰好對上 Amodei 要把此類評估者嵌進實驗室的呼籲。
frontier_other.analysis_en: Talent flowing into the evaluator named in the pacing plan is a structural signal, but METR’s forthcoming access rights at each lab are not yet public contracts.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 人才流向「放慢節奏」方案點名的評估機構是結構訊號，但 METR 在各實驗室的即將到來的存取權尚未成為公開合約。

brief_en: Labs talk of pacing, not pausing: Amodei’s evaluator plan draws Altman, Musk and Hassabis support; The Information says OpenAI, Anthropic and Google have met since July on an industry standards body. King Charles will convene lab leaders in Scotland. DeepSeek starts routing V4-Pro API traffic to V4.1-Flash today.
brief_zh: 大廠談「放慢節奏」而非停訓：Amodei 的駐廠評估承諾獲 Altman、Musk、Hassabis 呼應；《The Information》指三家自七月起討論產業標準機構。英王將在蘇格蘭召集實驗室高層。DeepSeek 今日起把 V4-Pro API 導向 V4.1-Flash。
